description: Unit tests for nl80211_client class, specifically testing channel utilization calculations based on survey info.

methods.name: get_channel_utilization_should_succeed_with_100_percent
methods.description: Tests that channel utilization is 100% when time busy equals time on.

methods.name: get_channel_utilization_should_succeed_with_50_percent
methods.description: Tests that channel utilization is 50% when time busy is half of time on.

methods.name: get_channel_utilization_should_succeed_with_0_percent
methods.description: Tests that channel utilization is 0% when time busy is zero.

methods.name: get_channel_utilization_should_fail_if_no_channel_in_use
methods.description: Ensures the function fails if the channel is not in use.

methods.name: get_channel_utilization_should_fail_if_time_on_is_zero
methods.description: Ensures the function fails if time on is zero.

methods.name: get_channel_utilization_should_fail_if_time_busy_is_greater_than_time_on
methods.description: Ensures the function fails if time busy exceeds time on.
